task_title: [P3] normalize-board hard-fails on ONE unparseable line and names no remedy — and --skip-bad-lines on the same command is a dead end (refuses to write), so 400+ rows of drift stay unrepaired
task_criteria: 1) The unparseable-line refusal from normalize-board names the remedy inline (line number + `validate --repair` → review tasks.rewritten.jsonl → swap → re-run normalize-board). 2) Either `--skip-bad-lines` on normalize-board becomes a usable degraded path that writes the repaired tasks.jsonl and preserves the dropped lines in a sidecar (e.g. tasks.skipped-lines.jsonl) with an explicit exit code, or the flag is removed from that command's help and the help points at validate --repair. 3) A fixture reproducing the duplicate-key line asserts the remedy text (grep for 'validate --repair' in the error output). 4) `go test ./...` exits 0.
